path_decisions.rationale: Pheromone strongest edge across ALL iterations (0.190). Win_rate objective in gate + profit targets in templates are the two infrastructure must-haves
After profit targets, entry relaxation is the next lever. Trend has 5 conditions (most restrictive), should be min_conditions=4
Vol breakout also 5-way AND (line 199-205). Plus its exit logic has no profit target — only atr_shrink and bb_middle_return
Mean reversion exit at bb_middle (line 100-103) causes whipsaw. Should exit at opposite BB band instead. Plus AND-logic 3-of-3 too restrictive

candidate_solution.summary: Comprehensive win-rate improvement package: gate win_rate objective + universal profit targets + per-strategy entry/exit tuning

phase_1_infrastructure: Add win_rate objective to optimizer._objective_value() — 1 line change in optimizer.py:160-169
Add win_rate objective to validation_gate — update gate.py:41 default and CPCV/WFO pass criteria
Create profit_target_exit() in _runtime.py — shared exit function used by all 6 templates
Create per-strategy param_space JSON files in config/strategies/
phase_2_entry_relaxation: Add min_conditions param to trend_following — change line 239 from AND to count>=min
Add min_conditions param to mean_reversion — change line 129-131 from AND to count>=min
Add min_conditions param to volatility_breakout — change line 199-205 from AND to count>=min
Add RSI threshold ranges to param_space for per-strategy optimization
phase_3_exit_improvement: Wire profit_target_exit() into all 6 templates' generate_signals()
Add trailing_stop_atr_mult to trend_following and volatility_breakout
Improve mean_reversion exit from bb_middle to opposite band
Add RSI-adaptive profit targets for trend_following
phase_4_signal_pipeline: Replace net-vote with strength-weighted consolidation in generator.py
Add per-strategy risk budgets to RiskEngine
Populate PositionSizer with per-strategy actual win_rate
implementation_package.estimated_win_rate_improvement: Current estimated ~40-50% → target 55-65% with all changes
implementation_package.key_risk: Over-optimization to win_rate may reduce profit_factor. The system should track both win_rate AND profit_factor simultaneously.

notes: The consistent finding across all 3 iterations and 12 ant explorations: 3 architectural gaps suppress win_rate — (1) no profit-taking exits, (2) overly restrictive AND-entry logic, (3) Sharpe-optimized validation. Fixing all three is estimated to improve win_rate from ~40-50% to 55-65%. The implementation order matters: infrastructure first (param_spaces + gate objective), then entry relaxation, then exit improvements, then signal pipeline fixes. Each phase builds on the previous.
